name: mac-calculator
description: MacOS Calculator App clone made with React.js and styled-components.

paragraphs: It's been a long time since my last React side project. This is a MacOS Calculator App clone (sorta) made with React.js ⚛️ and Styled Components 💅🏻. It supports the basic arithmetic operations as well as the % operator, which behaves like the one on the MacOs app. Now of course, it's not an exact 100% clone, but it's close enough. I allowed myself to diverge every now and then with some behaviors that I dislike of the MacOS Calculator. At any rate, I'm very happy with the results. Do let me know if you find any bugs.
